# Power Intent Studio -- runtime dependencies.
#
# Everything needed to RUN the app, and nothing else. Test-only packages
# live in requirements-dev.txt.
#
#     pip install -r requirements.txt
#     python power_intent_studio.py
#
# Requires Python 3.10 or newer (PySide6 6.11's own floor; the codebase
# itself uses no syntax newer than that). Verified on Python 3.13.
#
# Generated by scanning every import statement in the application source
# tree (backend/, frontend/, examples/, scripts/), not from assumption.
# Versions are pinned exactly: for a first release, reproducing a known-
# good environment matters more than flexibility.

# Qt bindings -- the entire GUI.
#PySide6==6.11.1
PySide6==6.9.3

# SystemVerilog/Verilog front end (Python bindings for the slang compiler).
pyslang==11.0.0

# Liberty (.lib) reader, for black-box macro pin/PG information.
# GPL-3.0-or-later -- see docs/milestone1_rtl_elaborator.md for the
# distribution/licensing note this carries.
liberty-parser==0.0.29

# Syntax highlighting in "Inspect Source File" (Verilog/SV/VHDL lexers).
# BSD-2-Clause.
Pygments==2.20.0
